Ministries and Outreach

Find your place to grow and serve. Every ministry has a way to get in touch.

Ministries
Women’s Ministry

The Deeper Life Women’s Ministry has played a key supporting role in Deeper Christian Life Ministry from the beginning, meeting the spiritual and family needs of women in the church and around the world. Through this ministry, multitudes of women have been saved, restored, sanctified, and Spirit-filled. Through God’s intervention, many separated families have been reunited and other family problems resolved.

Send us a message
about Women’s Ministry

Children’s Ministry

Children’s Church is an integral part of our church. It meets during the Sunday service for infants through 6th grade. Its purpose is to introduce children to all the provisions of God’s grace, help them have basic Christian experiences, and help them live a victorious Christian life in readiness for the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ. Its programs and activities evangelize, teach, and disciple children for Jesus, training them in the way of the Lord and equipping them to win their world for Christ. Our Children’s Ministry is part of the Children’s Ministry of Deeper Christian Life Ministry worldwide.

Send us a message
about Children’s Ministry

Youth Ministry

Our Youth Ministry helps young people in grades 7–12 know Christ, grow in God’s Word, and live for Him at school, at home, and among their friends. It grows out of Deeper Life Schools Outreach (DLSO), which began in 1979 when the General Superintendent held the first-ever Free Vacation School for secondary school students in Lagos State, Nigeria. That program transformed many young lives and motivated students to succeed academically, and the outreach has since served schools through groups such as Success Club and Christian Student Fellowship.

Send us a message
about Youth Ministry

Young Adults Ministry

The Deeper Life Young Adults Ministry challenges young adults to a life of holiness in a world that is anything but holy. Our vision is to see young people who are on fire for the things of God. We want to do His work, no matter the cost, and we invite you to join us! Programs run throughout the year and are announced as they come up; send us a message to find out what’s next.

Send us a message
about Young Adults Ministry

Men’s Ministry

The Men’s Ministry at Deeper Life Bible Church exists to build men into fully devoted followers of Christ: true disciples who answer His call, “Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men” (Matthew 4:19).

Let’s go a-fishing! Spread the Word!

Send us a message
about Men’s Ministry

Music Ministry

Our choir and musicians lead the congregation in worship through hymns, choruses, and special songs that honor God and prepare hearts to receive His Word. If you love the Lord and sing or play an instrument, we’d love for you to join us. Speak with an usher or contact us to learn more.

Send us a message
about Music Ministry

Outreach
Evangelism

Our Evangelism Ministry moves equipped and empowered believers to obey the Great Commission, taking the message of hope to a hopeless world (Matthew 28:19–20).

Send us a message
about Evangelism

Counseling

Our Counseling Ministry helps people learn to focus on God, the best Counselor. To speak with a pastor, contact the church. Counseling is not a crisis service: if you or someone you know is in danger, call 911, or call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.

Send us a message
about Counseling

Hospital Visitation

We visit and pray with people in the hospital, bringing them the comfort and hope of Christ. To request a visit for yourself or a loved one, contact the church.

Send us a message
about Hospital Visitation

Community Volunteerism

We serve our neighbors through the Heart of the City food distribution. Dates, times, and locations are announced in advance; contact us to volunteer.

Send us a message
about Community Volunteerism

Prison Ministry

Our Prison Ministry takes the hope of the Gospel to men and women in prison. Contact us to learn more or to get involved.

Send us a message
about Prison Ministry
